verdict.rationale: Quo is a shared-number team phone platform. Its docs show message and call history that can be filtered by contact, plus AI summaries attached to call records, which covers part of the team-visible per-contact history. However, no evidence shows calls and texts threaded together in one contact timeline, or contact notes the whole team sees; the per-contact filtering is documented through the MCP/agent interface, not the core workspace. Missing for 10: a documented unified per-contact thread of calls and texts, shared contact notes, explicit team-wide visibility of contact history, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, calls and texts thread under a contact with notes and history the whole team sees

citations.quote: Share one number and stay aligned with your team
Pull message history from any Quo inbox, filter by contact, date, or topic
Retrieve call history and voicemail transcripts from your Quo number.
Recorded calls come back transcribed and summarized, so no detail is missed and nobody has to take notes.
Call summaries are only available on business and scale plans.
